title: Sidewalk Inventory (2015)
description: Description: Sidewalk inventory for the City of Syracuse, largely based on aerials and supplemented by Google Street View photos. Some of the data in the inventory was field-verified. The "SW_Score_Value" field contains rough evaluations of sidewalk quality at the block level, done using aerials (not field verified). Certain sidewalk segments were digitized based on assumed clearing agencies (given in the "Adjacent_Park" field). Data Dictionary: Label Definition Definition Source ObjectID_1 Unique identifier for that section of road. Assigned by ArcGIS. Syracuse Metropolitan Transportation Council (SMTC) SW_Score_Value Measure of sidewalk completeness. 0 = sidewalks are absent 25 = partial sidewalk present in a block 50 = minor sidewalk gaps in the block and/or a mix of materials (concrete/asphalt) 75 = no sidewalk gaps in the block, mix of materials (concrete/asphalt) 100 = continuous concrete sidewalk Syracuse Metropolitan Transportation Council (SMTC) Name Street name Syracuse Metropolitan Transportation Council (SMTC) Council_District City of Syracuse Common Council District that this road falls within. Syracuse Metropolitan Transportation Council (SMTC) Adjacent_Park Park that is adjacent to this stretch of sidewalk, if applicable. Syracuse Metropolitan Transportation Council (SMTC) Adjacent_School School that is adjacent to this stretch of sidewalk, if applicable. Syracuse Metropolitan Transportation Council (SMTC) Mileage_2018 Length of road (Miles). Syracuse Metropolitan Transportation Council (SMTC) Dataset Contact Information: Organization: Syracuse Metropolitan Transportation Council Position Name: Senior Transportation Analyst City: Syracuse, NY Email: afrasier@smtcmpo.org
